format:

knitr:

```{r}
#| label: pkgs
#| include: false

use("nemo", "nemo_gha_mermaid")
use("here", "here")
```

```{r}
#| label: mermaid_diagram
#| include: false

diagram <- nemo_gha_mermaid(here(".github/workflows"))
```

````{r}
#| label: mermaid_diagram_cat
#| output: asis

cat("```{mermaid}\n", diagram, "\n```\n", sep = "")
````
